table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO
table.description: The additional data LOGON stores for a shipto in the 'Dispokarte'. A tlgnc_shipto extends a business partner of type ship-to as received from SAP in tlgns_sap_bp; there can be max 1 tlgnc_shipto per SAP BP. In the LOGON order model the destination of an order must be a shipto. If logically an order says 'go to a shippingpoint' / 'go to a plant' it is still going to a shipto, located at the same place.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The corresponding SAP BP, must be a ship-to (BP_IS_SHIPTO=1). There must be only one LOGON extension to an SAP SHIPTO. (Since 2.1.0.8, LOGON-6158: Forbid having 2 tlgnc_shipto for the very same SAP BP).

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive/deleted, 1=active. Flag is independent of TLGNS_SAP_SHIPTO.MARKED_FOR_DELETION, i.e. for technical reasons a Logon-Shipto may be inactivated, but the SAP Shipto is still valid. If an inactive shipto is used later on again, the ACTIVE_FLAG must be set to active again, and NOT creating an additional tlgnc_shipto for the same SAP BP!

column.name: SHIPTO_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_shipto_type_bs. Type of Shipto, e.g. 0=Standard, 1=Transporteurlager, 2=Location not fixed, 3=Bimodal (FVL), 4=Container Terminal, 5=Maintenance/Repair, 6=Plant, 7=Supplier.

column.name: OPEN1_FROM
column.description: Opening begin time 1 in minutes. Example: 540 for 09:00

column.name: OPEN1_TO
column.description: Opening end time 1 in minutes. Example: 720 for 12:00

column.name: OPEN2_FROM
column.description: Opening begin time 2 in minutes. Example: 780 for 13:00

column.name: OPEN2_TO
column.description: Opening end time 2 in minutes. Example: 1080 for 18:00

column.name: CONTACT_PERSON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_person. The main/default contact person for this shipto. All possible contact persons are stored in tlgnc_shipto_person; the default one should exist in this set as well (if not, this field will be set to null on next save).

column.name: SELF_SERVICE_FLAG
column.description: 1=Selbstabholer/Pickup. For a shipto where Pickup is possible, the Delivery Type 'Pickup' is possible. In Delivery Type 'Pickup', no dispatching will happen; no Pool or Carrier will be involved.

column.name: DAILY_ORDER_CONTACT_FLAG
column.description: Used to mark big Shiptos, where a daily order is expected: If set, customer should be contacted (by a sales agent) when no order were entered for today (typically to be delivered on next workingday).

column.name: DAILY_ORDER_LAST_CONTACT_DAT
column.description: Date + Time when user was contacted last time concerning 'no orders yet today' but daily_order_contact_flag=1.

column.name: DAILY_ORDER_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_daily_order_status_bs. Status/Resolution of the daily order contact call. E.g. Not reachable, No order today, etc.

column.name: SIGNATURE_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_signature_type_bs. If a signature is expected when delivering or not: 0=mandatory, 1=optional, 2=no signature.

column.name: COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude coordinates of the shipto

column.name: COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute coordinates of the shipto

column.name: COORD_FIX_FLAG
column.description: Whether coordinations are fix. 0=the coordinates will be updated with the next incoming information from a PDA. Editing the coordinates in the User Interface is still possible.

column.name: GEOFENCE_RADIUS
column.description: The geofence radius of the shipto in meters. The initial value is taken from tlgnr_config, app.default.shippingpoint_shipto.GeofenceRadius_m and then set explicitly in every shipto. No automatic update when default changes.

column.name: UNLOADING_TIME_CEM_MIN
column.description: The estimated time (duration in minutes) needed for unloading a truck with CEMENT material. Value is used for the calculation of the times when dispositioning the trucks, see tlgnc_assignment and tlgnc_assignment_part.unloading time of the shipto (in minutes after midnight). Default from app.default.shipto.UnloadingTime_CEM_min.

column.name: UNLOADING_TIME_AGG_MIN
column.description: The estimated time (duration in minutes) needed for unloading a truck with AGGREGATED material. Value is used for the calculation of the times when dispositioning the trucks, see tlgnc_assignment and tlgnc_assignment_part.unloading time of the shipto (in minutes after midnight). Default from app.default.shipto.UnloadingTime_AGG_min.

column.name: LOADING_TIME_LF_MIN
column.description: The estimated time (duration in minutes) needed to load a LANDFILL order at the shipto. Default from app.default.shipto.loadingTime_LF_min.

column.name: RAIL_CHAIN_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. This link is used for rail orders, it defines the shippingpoint from where the next (e.g. return) rail order starts after it has arrived or emptied at this shipto. Shipto-type and shippingpoint-type follow some patterns: a) repair -> rail repair SP, b) plant -> rail SP, c) supplier -> rail supplier SP, d) FVL/Container Terminal -> rail extern/return (not FVL/Container shippingpoint; those types are used for the LOADING side, see mat_chain_shippoingpoint_id, not as an artificial return shippingpoint), f) standard -> rail extern/return.

column.name: MAT_CHAIN_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. Only applicable for ship-to type FVL or Container Terminal: it points to the shippingpoint at the same spot where the material/load can be picked up by a follow-up order. For FVL: FVL Shipto Rail -> FVL Shippingpoint Truck. For Container Terminal: normally Rail -> Truck, but the reverse case Truck -> Rail also exists.

column.name: RAIL_HOLD_BACK_RE_ORDER_FLAG
column.description: If the flag is set to true, no automatic order for sending back the empty wagon is created (Leerwagenmeldung zurueckhalten). Business case describes this flag as useful for 'FVL'-Shipto, but it makes sense also for Container Terminals, and probably other rail-shipto's as well.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_cd. Only applicable for ship-to type Plant. It defines which plant a shipto actually represents when goods are delivered to here. The information is send to SAP.

column.name: PAPER_SINGLE_DELNOTE_FLAG_CEM
column.description: Enable the printing of the Single Delivery Note at the shipping point in case of a cement order.

column.name: PAPER_SINGLE_DELNOTE_FLAG_AGG
column.description: Enable the printing of the Single Delivery Note at the shipping point in case of an Aggregates or Landfill order.

column.name: PAPER_COLL_DELNOTE_FLAG_CEM
column.description: Enable the printing of the Collective Delivery Note at the shipping point in case of a cement order.

column.name: PAPER_COLL_DELNOTE_FLAG_AGG
column.description: Enable the printing of the Collective Delivery Note at the shipping point in case of an Aggregates/Landfill order.

column.name: EMAIL_DELIVNOTE_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note (Lieferschein) by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES. The flag has an effect during order status set to finished.

column.name: FAX_DELIVNOTE_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER. The flag has an effect during order status set to finished.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES
column.description: E-mail addresses (separated by comma) to be used for order confirmation note and/or delivery note (BB and LS checkboxes in the German user interface).

column.name: ORDER_CONF_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER
column.description: Fax number to be used for order confirmation note and/or delivery note (BB and LS checkboxes in the German user interface). Enter as +41 44 123456, i.e. country code mandatory and only space allowed for grouping.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_SMS_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by SMS should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER.

column.name: ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER
column.description: Phone number to be used for order confirmation note (BB checkbox in the German user interface. Delivery note by SMS is not supported). Enter as +41 44 123456, i.e. country code mandatory and only space allowed for grouping.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_SMS_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by SMS should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER.

column.name: NOTE_ORDER_MGMT
column.description: Note for the order management (Auftragsmanagement)

column.name: NOTE_DELIVERY
column.description: Note for the delivery (Zusatz Lieferschein)

column.name: NOTE_DISPATCHING
column.description: Note for the dispatching (Pool/Spediteur)

column.name: NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER
column.description: Note for the truck driver (Chauffeur)

column.name: NOTE_RAILWAY_DISP
column.description: Note for the railway disposition (Bahndisposition)

column.name: SBB_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
column.description: SBB Customer Number editable in dispocard

column.name: TRAIN_STATION_UNLOADING_POINT
column.description: Train station unloading point as editable in dispocard
